archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Grand Theft Auto VI sets PlayStation’s biggest launch record

entries.headline: Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown hands-on covers naval combat, diving and management
entries.summary: AUTOMATON's hands-on report covers the first major expansion. Alongside follow-up stories for three characters and consecutive boss battles, it adds maritime commissions, sailing and diving, and expands romance, marriage, management and housing systems.
entries.verification: The report details the mechanics firsthand. This is new coverage, not a new launch of the expansion released October 30.
entries.timeNote: The cited report was published at 12:34 Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Gothic 1 Remake’s PS5 digital release in Japan is delayed indefinitely
entries.summary: Famitsu relays THQ Nordic's announcement that work on adjustments for Japan requires more time. The PS5 download originally due November 24 no longer has a release date, and preorders will be refunded.
entries.verification: The cited Famitsu relay supports this for the Japanese PS5 digital edition, not other regions or platforms.
entries.timeNote: The Famitsu relay was collected within the fixed window; an exact publication time was not established in the packet.

entries.headline: Discord tests Auto Clips to save gameplay highlights based on voice reactions
entries.summary: The early test can save clips when it detects laughter or screams in voice chat. League of Legends, Rocket League, Counter-Strike 2 and Dota 2 are the first titles to support game-event triggers. Discord is rolling it out to Nitro subscribers.
entries.verification: The report relays Discord's announcement and limits the feature to the early Nitro test.
entries.timeNote: The cited report was published at 09:32 Beijing time on November 24, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI sets PlayStation’s biggest game launch record
entries.summary: IGN, citing PlayStation, reports 683 million hours played in the opening days, averaging roughly 17.4 hours per player. The launch also set a single-day record for newly connected PS5 consoles.
entries.verification: IGN relays PlayStation's figures. The item uses only the figures and records stated in that report.
entries.timeNote: The cited report was published at 08:14 Beijing time on November 24, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Monster-collecting roguelike Dokimon Frontier announced as a free Steam release
entries.summary: Yanako RPGs announced a December 2026 Steam launch. Players recruit Dokimon to fight across different environments and take on bosses, with a Boss Rush mode also included.
entries.verification: The report relays the developer announcement; there is no exact release day in the cited evidence.
entries.timeNote: The cited report was published at 14:06 Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: SO-JI -Why Why Japanese- SHINJUKU announced with a playable Steam demo
entries.summary: Developer ゲラッパ announced the Shinjuku-set cleaning action game for PC via Steam. The demo went live on November 24; the full game has no release date.
entries.verification: The cited developer announcement is distinct from the store page made public in August.
entries.timeNote: The cited report was published at 09:00 Beijing time on November 24, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Acts of Blood delayed to spring 2027 on PC
entries.summary: Big Fan Games and Eksil Team moved the PC release from December 4, 2026 to spring 2027. The PS5 and Xbox Series versions are still planned for 2027.
entries.verification: Gematsu relays the publisher and developer announcement; no exact date is stated for spring 2027.
entries.timeNote: The cited report was published at 17:00 Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Nioh 3: Bloody Insurrection launches December 17; Complete Edition follows in January
entries.summary: Koei Tecmo and Team NINJA announced the expansion for December 17, 2026. The Complete Edition, including the base game and both expansions, is slated for January 28, 2027 on PS5, Xbox Series and PC.
entries.verification: Gematsu relays the announcement and supports the dates, versions and platforms stated here.
entries.timeNote: The cited report was published at 09:41 Beijing time on November 24, within the fixed window.
entries.releaseTypeLabel: DLC and Complete Edition release dates

entries.headline: NVIDIA reinstates Jensen Huang as president and CEO
entries.summary: 4Gamer reports that NVIDIA's board voted unanimously on November 23 US time to reinstate its co-founder as president, CEO and board director, effective immediately.
entries.verification: 4Gamer relays NVIDIA's announcement. The item is limited to the named roles and immediate effective date.
entries.timeNote: The cited report was published at 22:55 Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Darkest Dungeon II: The Butcher’s Asylum showcases a standalone arena mode
entries.summary: 4Gamer covered the DLC's presentation at WePlay Expo 2026. The standalone mode pits players against successive arena opponents, and delighting the crowd builds resources used to unleash a finisher.
entries.verification: 4Gamer's on-site report describes the stage presentation and the structure of the mode.
entries.timeNote: The cited report was published at 15:58 Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Wave Race: Blue Storm joins Nintendo GameCube Nintendo Classics
entries.summary: The 2001 GameCube racer is now playable for Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack subscribers.
entries.verification: The report relays Nintendo's announcement and identifies the required membership tier.
entries.timeNote: The cited report was published at 09:43 Beijing time on November 24, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI developers memorialize late family members in-game
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that two developers confirmed the names of their late mother, father and daughter appear on an in-game memorial wall.
entries.verification: The account is based on the two developers' public posts; no other names are asserted.
entries.timeNote: The cited report was published at 17:39 Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Analysts report a Call of Duty player drop of more than 40% after GTA VI’s opening weekend
entries.summary: IGN cites Alinea Analytics in reporting a decline of more than 40% in players of the Call of Duty app after Grand Theft Auto VI's first weekend.
entries.verification: The percentage is a third-party estimate reported by IGN, not a publisher disclosure.
entries.timeNote: The cited report was published at 07:37 Beijing time on November 24, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: D’Angelo’s estate confirms unreleased track ‘Kamikaze’ appears in Grand Theft Auto VI
entries.summary: IGN reports the estate confirmed that D'Angelo created the previously unreleased song for the game in 2024.
entries.verification: The cited estate statement confirms the song name, year and its inclusion in the game.
entries.timeNote: The cited report was published at 03:56 Beijing time on November 24, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: indiePlay China Indie Game Awards 2026 draws over 700 entries but names no top-prize winner
entries.summary: 4Gamer's report from WePlay Expo 2026 says more than 700 projects were submitted, but no entry met the criteria for the top award.
entries.verification: The on-site account of the November 22 Shanghai ceremony supports the submission count and the decision not to confer the top prize.
entries.timeNote: The cited report was published at 11:26 Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.
